QuestInfo.name: Something Even Humans Can Eat
QuestInfo.0: It looks like Moonbeam is done wondering. You should go talk to Moonbeam.
QuestInfo.1:
The only thing that sounded edible from the list of food Moonbeam suggested was Sparrow Eggs.
Go hunt #bSparrows#k at the #bTear Rock Hill#k and gather 10 #bSparrow Eggs#k.
QuestInfo.2: Fortunately, there is some edible food around here. You hunted some Sparrows near the village and secured some Sparrow Eggs.
